messages:
Nora (AP): CloudBridge Accounting asked whether to upload a W-8 or W-9 for invoice 44100 and they flagged a gross-up clause in their SOW. AP needs tax/legal before releasing payment.

CloudBridge Accounting: Hi Redwood, CloudBridge here. We're a US-formed LLC but 80% owned by an EU parent. Which form should we put in your portal? Our SOW says Redwood will "gross-up" payments to cover any withholding. Portal: https://pay.cloudbridge.io/inv/44100

Nora (AP): Tagging @Sam (Tax) and @Claire (Legal). No TIN/EIN on the PDF; AP placed the invoice on hold.

Sam (Tax): Quick rules: if they have an EIN and are taxed in the US -> W-9. If they claim foreign status -> W-8BEN-E plus evidence. Foreign ownership doesn't automatically make the US LLC foreign for IRS purposes.

Jorge (Vendor Ops): Invoice shows "CloudBridge LLC" and a US address but we neglected to include the EIN. We'll upload whichever you need.

Claire (Legal): On gross-up: our standard posture is we do not accept automatic gross-up obligations. If the countersigned SOW includes it and was intentionally accepted by Commercial, we escalate cost impact. Otherwise we seek amendment. Please attach the executed SOW page.

Nora (AP): Placed hold: AP note "Awaiting W-9 w/ EIN or valid W-8BEN-E + Legal confirmation on gross-up. Do not pay." invoice-bot: ON_HOLD.

invoice-bot: Invoice 44100 status: ON_HOLD \u2014 reason: missing tax form and contract clause review.

CloudBridge Accounting: Uploaded W-9 and provided EIN 33-4445556. Attached the SOW excerpt with gross-up clause.

Sam (Tax): I'll validate EIN/TIN. If W-9 checks out we classify them as US payee  no withholding. Gross-up is commercial, not tax-mandated.

Sam (Tax): EIN validated via TIN match. Recommendation: treat as US payee, no withholding. Do NOT apply gross-up unless Legal/Commercial confirm contractual obligation.

Claire (Legal): I reviewed the SOW excerpt; clause is present and appeared in a countersigned SOW. I'm escalating to Commercial to confirm whether that was approved. Until Commercial signs off, do not release payment based on that clause alone.

Jorge (Vendor Ops): Understood. We can accept an amendment if needed.

Nora (AP): Action items: Sam mark vendor as US payee, Claire escalate to Commercial, AP to hold payment until Commercial confirms. Closing when payment released.

invoice-bot: Invoice 44100 remains ON_HOLD. Last update: W-9 validated, pending Commercial decision on SOW gross-up clause.
